page_title: ARS 5-0 LEE | Arsenal v Leeds 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' 5 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Lucas Perri no chance!
90+4' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+3' Dangerous play by Anton Stach (Leeds). Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Arsenal.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Samuel Byram (Leeds) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
86' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Arsenal.
83' Daniel Farke prepares a substitution. Jayden Bogle is replaced by Samuel Byram (Leeds).

81' Max Dowman (Arsenal) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
80' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) for his blatant foul.
78' The shots on goal statistics – 4:1.

75' Fine play by Max Dowman (Arsenal) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
73' Max Dowman (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
73' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.
72' The attendance is 60110.
69' Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
66' Substitution. Noah Okafor (Leeds) replaces Wilfried Gnonto.
66' That's the end of the game for Daniel James, who is replaced by Brenden Aaronson (Leeds).
64' The game has come to an end for Jurrien Timber. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Cristhian Mosquera (Arsenal).
64' Here is a change. Riccardo Calafiori is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal).
64' Substitution. Noni Madueke makes way for Max Dowman (Arsenal).

62' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
61' Arsenal are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
59' Referee Jarred Gillett points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) goes wild in celebration.
58' Daniel Farke has decided to substitute Joel Piroe and he is replaced by Lukas Nmecha (Leeds).
58' A substitution has been made. Ao Tanaka is replaced by Sean Longstaff (Leeds).
58' Wait! Referee Jarred Gillett has indicated he is going to review the Arsenal goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
56' 4 - 0 Goal! Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 4:0.
56' Declan Rice (Arsenal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
56' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
53' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is being substituted because of an injury. Mikel Arteta sends Leandro Trossard on the pitch.
51' The game is interrupted now, Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

48' 3 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 3:0. Lucas Perri was helpless.
47' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The whistle blows and Jarred Gillett starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+1' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Jurrien Timber laid the ball off to Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), who unleashed a strong shot from close range into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
40' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Mikel Arteta is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Martin Odegaard suffers an injury and Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) comes on.
36' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:3. 1:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
34' 1 - 0 Gooal! Declan Rice takes over corner duties. Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the right side of the net. 1:0.
33' Declan Rice (Arsenal) prepares to take a corner kick.
31' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
30' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
27' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
25' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
21' The resulting set piece from Leeds is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

20' What a great chance for Pascal Struijk (Leeds). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. Leeds force a corner. They send men into the box.
20' Joel Piroe (Leeds) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
19' Daniel James (Leeds) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play. Leeds are awarded a corner kick.
18' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) passes the ball onto Viktor Gyökeres, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
16' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
15' The free kick picks out Gabriel (Arsenal) in space, but his close-range header flies miles past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.

14' Anton Stach (Leeds) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jarred Gillett with no other option than to blow for a foul.
13' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break. 61:39 – the ratio of ball possession.
10' Declan Rice (Arsenal) attempts to find Bukayo Saka, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
10' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the free kick which is inaccurate and the defence has no problem with the clearance.
9' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.

8' Nice move, nice attempt! Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
7' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for an infringement.
6' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
2' A pass from Noni Madueke (Arsenal) is intercepted by Lucas Perri and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Leeds will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Jarred Gillett is the one to supervise the game today.
